required_evidence: Construct a Hausdorff topology on the same underlying set and prove that its identity map to the original space is continuous.
Prove equality of all specified profinite probe records and idempotence of reconstruction.
Establish both directions of the natural bijection between natural transformations and continuous maps of reconstructed spaces, including compatibility with identities and composition.
critical_errors: Claim that profinite probes recover every original Hausdorff topology unchanged.
Assume original spaces are already compactly generated.
Choose the wrong direction for the final topology or the identity X-dagger→X.
Recover only a point map from a natural transformation without proving its continuity between reconstructed spaces.
Use all cardinalities of probes or beta-D without checking the fixed universe bound.
completion_policy: Completion requires the reconstruction and natural correspondence in the stated universe. Accept any equivalent proof. The compact-Hausdorff comparison, coreflection formulation, and Fortissimo counterexample are optional reference developments, not extra mandatory tasks.
open_task_policy: Accept independently verified alternative constructions, counterexamples and unexpected results. Explicit conditional results are valid contributions but do not by themselves settle the original scope. Honest incompleteness is distinct from an invalid proof.
